DISCOVER.requirement: Use only this root continuity ID and original PR/work lanes.

reads: if infrastructure: authorized MCP inventory and S1 observations
RECONCILE_LIVE.requirement: Snapshots are not live truth; record observed HEAD/UTC when available.

MAP_CURRENT_ACTIVITY.requirement: Identify WPs, dependencies, next action, ongoing claims, branch owners and resources.

DETECT_DUPLICATES.requirement: No new PR/branch/issue/scheduler if existing authority suffices. No duplicated simultaneous writers on branch, file, server or work package.

CHECK_MANDATE.requirement: Explicit user mandate must cover every mutation and resource; documentation does not authorize active scan, patch or deploy.

VERIFY_CLAIMS_AND_LOCKS.requirement: Check existing external MCP claims/locks when relevant; if unavailable, do not claim a lock and avoid conflicting concurrent write. Resource claims not inherited across repos.

PLAN_MINIMAL_DELTA.requirement: Append-only documentation when possible; preserve exact existing scope, acceptance and non-regression.

WRITE_EXACT_HEAD.requirement: Fetch latest branch SHA immediately before write. Create commit with latest parent and update branch with expected_sha + force:false; on stale lease stop, re-read and reconcile.

VERIFY_RESULTS.requirement: Read new HEAD/files and relevant CI by exact SHA; distinguish structural validation, code security, runtime status.

APPEND_CHECKPOINT.requirement: Publish checkpoint in issue #5, link PR #7, record operation evidence and unresolved gaps. Do not erase prior checkpoints.

HANDOFF.requirement: Provide current root ID, issue, PR, head observed, done/not done, next action and missing evidence for new chat.

priority: P2S-NEXT-001 remains business next until changed by canonical evidence; documentary recording does not close it.
security: Public repository: never publish secrets, tokens, personal data, private customer code or raw sensitive logs.

session_schema.operation_reference: an existing PR/issue/comment or unique documentary operation key (not a second continuity ID)
